title: Lean cross-check of the A5 branch-aware conditional-composition contract
evidence_level: T0 exact contract sidecar with pinned Lean, independent re-derivation and fail-closed hostile checks
question: Can the already published A5 T6 branch-aware conditional-composition contract be checked independently for its seven-hypothesis identity, disjoint branch topology and source-derived shell-mass firewall without changing the existing proof method or tier?
assumptions: The operator-confirmed A5 T6 conditional-composition manifest and its hash-pinned authorities are the source contract.

The Lean propositions are an exact sidecar for conjunction identity, branch separation and the declared rational mass-fork oracle; analytic A1--A4 arguments remain supplied by their existing authorities.
The primary lane may re-execute the enacted A5 package into a temporary output without changing historical run records.
The non-importing independent lane and hostile mutations are treated as audit evidence, not as new premises for the A5 theorem.
missing_assumptions: A hash-pinned source-owned TECT production generator or transfer operator with state, projection, filtration and time-boundary contract.
A common invariant core and norm across cutoff, lattice, volume, boundary, phase and beta regulators.
Uniform estimates and an ordered cutoff/volume/continuum limit for the production dynamics.
A physical-sector map, observation correspondence, holdout data and QFT/Yang--Mills/gravity identification.
A full derivative Class-II constructive measure, BCC existence/selection and any physical vacuum theorem.
non_claims: This sidecar does not re-prove the analytic A1--A4 or A5 composition theorem.
The Lean rational constants are test oracles re-derived from pinned manifests, not new physical predictions.
No source-owned dynamics, common core, uniform estimate, ordered limit, physical vacuum, Pre-A, Sector-A closure, QFT, Yang--Mills, gravity or mass gap follows.
The existing forward T-054 and observation-first T-059/T-061 methods and owner order are unchanged.
falsifiers: Any source manifest, authority, script or Lean registry hash mismatch.
Failure to compile R475.lean with the pinned Lean 4.32.1 toolchain or presence of an escape token.
Primary and non-importing independent lanes disagree on the theorem-contract digest or derived mass fork.
Any hostile mutation of hypotheses, branch topology, tier, publication state, numeric fork, exclusions, authority hash or operator confirmation is accepted.
Any result is cited as a new analytic, physical, continuum or Yang--Mills conclusion.

adversarial_review.check: The weakness map is beside the theorem contract in the canonical source; a validator that looks in the wrong location could reject the valid baseline or silently omit the open rows.
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED after the hostile validator was corrected to require the canonical top-level placement and the unmutated contract passed.

adversarial_review.check: A scalar-continuum conclusion could be appended to the full-production chain or the two branches could be treated as parameter-identical.
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED by exact disjoint branch arrays, theorem digest and merge-branch hostile mutation.

adversarial_review.check: The shell masses could be copied into the audit instead of re-derived from the pinned kernel and functional manifests.
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: both Python lanes derive Decimal values from source files; Lean constants are explicitly labelled test oracles and the hostile mass-fork mutation fails closed.

adversarial_review.check: A sidecar PASS could be mistaken for a new T6/T7 analytic or physical result.
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED by T0/claim_bearing=false, unchanged method flags, explicit non-claims and promotion-scope firewall.

adversarial_review.check: A small formal script could be described as proving A5 analysis or a continuum/physical theorem.
adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: Lean entrypoint contains only conjunction, separation and rational-oracle propositions; all missing assumptions remain explicit.

contract.mass_firewall: full and scalar shell masses are re-derived independently and must remain separated by the declared threshold

lean.role: Lean checks only contract identity, branch separation and exact rational test-oracle consequences; it does not formalise the A5 analytic arguments, source dynamics, common core, limits or physical sector.

boundary: R-475 is a T0 contract sidecar. It improves exact arithmetic and provenance assurance for the enacted A5 T6 boundary but supplies no new analytic premise, source-owned dynamics, common core, uniform estimate, ordered limit, physical-sector map or QFT/Yang--Mills result.
next_action: Keep the T-054 owner gate and the T-059/T-061 inverse lane unchanged. The next mainline advance requires a real source-owned production dynamics packet; until then do not repeat finite physical-empty or BCC variants.
reconsider_if: The canonical A5 manifest or its authority hashes change; issue a new sidecar version rather than mutating R-475.
A source-owned production generator, common core and uniform estimates arrive; instantiate the ordered-limit contract in a new mainline result.
Any child lane fails, a hostile mutation is accepted or Lean no longer compiles; retain the failure artifact and reopen the audit before citing R-475.
